implementation.continuity: Stable page order, no implicit six-tab eviction, explicit reopening and last-tab focus; editor remains mounted across reading modes.
implementation.panes: Existing react-resizable-panels v4.6.5; keyboard/pointer separator; orientation by reading-area width; separate horizontal/vertical preferences by actor/workspace/campaign.
implementation.drafts: Actor/workspace/page draft namespace. Accepted saves settle only submitted text; later edits retain an advanced base and resume autosave. Late responses cannot replace another page or actor editor.
implementation.conflicts: Explicit local/server review; keep saved version or apply local draft against reviewed version. Existing atomic version check retained.
implementation.boundaries: No schema, SQL migration, flag, service payload, dependency or font changes. No new CSS modules, global links, important declarations or global observers.

localEvidence.quality: Final npm run check passed: styles/project, lint without warnings, typecheck, 131 suites/575 tests, client and SSR production build.

extendedBrowser.execution: Two intercepted fixture runs: 320/390 and 820/1440; results written after each viewport. Desktop filters and optional groups exercised at 1440.

localEvidence.visualReview: Screenshots with installed Cormorant Garamond, Inter and PT Mono fixtures: initial full pages at four widths; final document/graph/tree/library crops at 320/390/820. Final functional rerun uses 500-page fixtures at all four widths. Native devices and GPUs were not certified.

limitations: Backend requests and realtime are intercepted fixtures, not real-account or RLS evidence.
Real authorized corpus/roles/rollout follow NEX-010, reconciled in DEC-010; the original acceptance text is preserved.
Unowned legacy drafts are preserved in storage and not adopted by another account.
No cross-device preference sync, arbitrary pane docking, vault or Obsidian plugins.
No physical device, native screen-reader or GPU certification.
Sent requests are not revoked; scope guards protect local editor feedback rather than certify server authorization.
